faqs.a:
The municipal court is hereby authorized to issue a temporary or permanent civil protection
               order against an adult or against a juvenile who is ten years of age or older to prevent
               assaults and threatened bodily harm, or to prevent domestic abuse, in any proceeding
               pending before the municipal court, and in accordance with C.R.S. §§ 13-14-101 and
               13-14-102.
(Code 1981, § 18-18; Ord. No. 2846, § 1, 9-3-1991; Ord. No. 3873, § 1, 5-3-2004)
